methodology: Manual review of the full text by the ContractLens developer agent (Claude, an AI model) — not by a lawyer. An 'item' is a clause a typical consumer could reasonably consider unfavourable or risky (privacy, financial, contractual, unfavourable term). 'ambiguous' lists clauses where reasonable reviewers could disagree; predictions matching them are counted separately, neither TP nor FP. Each item lists one or more verbatim anchor sentences; any one anchor overlapping a prediction's verified quote counts as a match.
